findings.title_ro: Noul obiect Limits elimină și plafonul de conexiuni, nu numai keepalive
findings.requirement: Preserve existing limits except the expressly intended idle connection retirement; user explicitly requires no change to authority/retries/limits.
findings.concrete_case: Construct FixedClient with a no-op guard, without sending any request, on baseline and candidate under HTTPX 0.28.1 / HTTPcore 1.0.9. The baseline HTTPTransport default supplies max_connections=100; httpx.Limits(max_keepalive_connections=0) instead defaults max_connections=None, represented by HTTPcore as 9223372036854775807. Thus a separate finite limit is demonstrably widened in the exact candidate.
findings.smallest_fix: Set limits=httpx.Limits(max_connections=100, max_keepalive_connections=0). Extend the focused regression to preserve the preexisting finite connection cap, rerun the affected source tests, then request focused re-review on the new hashes.
findings.impact_and_limit: This is a measured configuration-contract violation, not evidence of 101 concurrent requests or an active resource-exhaustion incident. The current native poller is serial and the relay still admits one connection. Those unchanged guards limit practical exposure but do not make the explicit no-unrelated-limit-change claim true.
